title: Medicare Open Enrollment: How to Get to Your Appointments This Fall
summary: Medicare Open Enrollment runs Oct 15 to Dec 7. What to gather, where to get free unbiased help, and how to get to every appointment without driving.
body_markdown:

For anyone who no longer drives, GoGoGrandparent can arrange rides to all of them with one phone call, and deliver prescriptions so there's one less errand. You'll find the dates, a short checklist for your counseling appointment, and ways to get there without driving.


Choosing a plan is a personal decision, and Medicare or your local SHIP counselor can help you compare. What GoGoGrandparent can help with is the running around.


## **When is Medicare Open Enrollment in 2026?**


Medicare Open Enrollment runs from **October 15 to December 7** . During that window, people with Medicare can join, switch, or drop a Medicare Advantage Plan or a Medicare drug plan, or switch to Original Medicare. Any change takes effect **January 1, 2027** , and the plan has to receive the enrollment form by December 7.


If you've reviewed your options and you're happy with your current coverage,[Medicare says](https://www.medicare.gov/publications/11220-your-yearly-medicare-review.pdf) you don't need to do anything. It continues automatically.


## **What should you gather before comparing Medicare plans?**


If you have a Medicare health or drug plan, you should receive its Annual Notice of Change in September. It explains changes to your coverage and costs for next year. If it never arrived, Medicare suggests calling the plan.


Before sitting down to compare, it helps to have these on the kitchen table:


- **The Annual Notice of Change letter.**
- **Your Medicare card** , plus the card for any plan you have now.
- **A list of prescriptions** , with the dose and how often each one is taken.
- **Every doctor's name** , including the specialist seen once or twice a year.
- **The pharmacy you use** , or two or three you'd be willing to use.


Doctors and pharmacies matter more than most people expect. Medicare notes that costs, benefits, and providers can change each year, so check that your doctors and pharmacy are in the network of any plan under consideration.[Medicare's Plan Finder](https://www.medicare.gov/plan-compare) can search for them.


## **Where can you get free, unbiased help with Medicare?**


Medicare points people to two official sources, and neither one is selling anything.


- **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227).** Open 24 hours a day, weekends included. TTY users can call 1-877-486-2048.
- **The State Health Insurance Assistance Program, or SHIP.** SHIP offers one-on-one Medicare counseling, and[there is no cost to use it](https://www.shiphelp.org/what-we-do/about-ships/) . Depending on the local program, counseling can happen by phone or in person. Call 877-839-2675 or visit shiphelp.org to find the nearest one.


If you prefer talking face to face, ask your local SHIP about an in-person appointment. Bring the list, sit down with a counselor, and go through the options together.


Open Enrollment season also brings a pile of mail and phone calls from companies selling Medicare products. Medicare's advice is to rely on Medicare.gov, the "Medicare & You" handbook, and 1-800-MEDICARE for unbiased information.

Family members helping with Open Enrollment can be added to the account, and then they can book rides too. That's especially handy for adult children who live in another city and can't drive a parent themselves.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **When does Medicare Open Enrollment start and end?**


Medicare Open Enrollment runs from October 15 to December 7. Changes made this fall take effect January 1, 2027.


### **Do I have to do anything during Open Enrollment?**


Not necessarily. If you've reviewed your plan's notices and your options and you're happy with your current coverage, it continues automatically.


### **Where can I get free help comparing Medicare plans?**


Call 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227), or contact your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) at 877-839-2675 or shiphelp.org for free one-on-one counseling.
